title: Skills JIT context lint — real frontmatter parse, enforced entry-context budget, resource validation
acceptance_condition: Parse the actual frontmatter, enforce a deliberate entry-context budget and validate referenced resources; preserve documented suppressions without treating them as semantic validation.

implementation.max_entry_lines_provenance: carried over unchanged from the line-grep lint's `-gt 250` threshold
checks: FRONTMATTER — real YAML frontmatter block: --- on line 1, a closing --- line, top-level `name` and `description` as non-empty scalars inside the block; quoted values, block scalars (|/>), comments and nested mappings understood; empty/sequence-only/unclosed blocks fail; fields appearing only in the body fail
BUDGET — SKILL.md <= MAX_ENTRY_LINES, or references/ exists AND holds at least one readable file; an empty references/ no longer satisfies progressive disclosure

RESOURCE — every relative references/, scripts/, assets/ path cited by SKILL.md (markdown links, inline backtick paths, bare paths on their own line, outside fenced blocks) must resolve; a miss fails with skill, line and path

suppression.mechanism: the documented `lint-ok` line marker (plus the historical STALE prose-context words DEAD/retired/legacy/deprecated/'is not'/'never target')
suppression.semantics: suppressed hits are listed under a separate `-- suppressed --` heading and counted in the summary; they never count as semantic validation and cannot wave through a FRONTMATTER defect

reproducer_cases_now_fixed.finding: BUDGET … references/ holds no readable file — progressive disclosure not satisfied

cases: empty frontmatter with body fields fails
suppression is reported in the summary

real_tree_run.summary: OK — skills estate clean (125 skills, MAX_ENTRY_LINES=250, 40 suppressed)

resource_violations_found_and_fixed.diagnosis: repo-root script cited with a skill-relative path
sibling skill's reference cited as if it were this skill's
deliberate day-2 forward reference; the kb scripts are planned, not shipped
resource_violations_found_and_fixed.fix: recorded through the documented suppression mechanism with a lint-ok comment; reported as SUPPRESSED, not as validated
